verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 100.9 (-5.3% in a day) and momentum is 43: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,000 and 86s 4,400. The weekend is ending, and prices usually ease into Monday.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-09T01:20:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Weekend is ending: wait before buying
moves.detail: Prices usually ease as the weekend ends and players sell their squads. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-12T07:59:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,400 (1.07 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,400 (1.16 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,000 (1.45 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: João Mário and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: João Mário 76 Rare -56.5%; Hugo Lloris 75 Rare -40.0%; Charlie Cresswell 78 Rare -40.0%; Sam Kerr 85 Rare -38.9%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
